GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Outside Leader .5 Lengths 1600m 2nd .5 Lengths 1200m 2nd .5 Lengths 800m 2nd .5 Lengths home turn Under Pressure Hard Ridden 3rd 2 Lengths Middle Of Track weakened final 200m # on pace/poor run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance, rider stated that his mount did not handle the increase in distance and may be suited to racing over shorter distances. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (visors off, nose roll again) jumped out ok . Settled Down Two Wide 5th 2.5 Lengths @ 1300m. Hard Ridden givin Ground on home Turn . balanced up and Kept Trying . # stuck to task
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped another runner on jumping. Rider reported mount travelled keenly in the early stages. Stated as tempo quickened, was reluctant to respond to urgings to improve passing the 600m and was under full riding vigour rounding the bend. Responded fairly in the straight but did not quicken significantly in the run to the line.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 1000m, Ridden Along soon after Straightening Up and wanted to get head on side, run ended last 200m and weakened # run peaked 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away evenly. Pushed fwd & shared lead on inside early . Stayed =lead on inside midrace & pushed to hold ground @ 450m. Gave ground from home turn. blinkers off again / visors 1st time. # On-pace/tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider dropped her whip approaching the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4l off, battled on one pace # held ground

Knuckled @ start. Rolled fwd & raced keenly 5th on inside (3L from lead) early . Held Ground midrace until pushed to quicken @ 500m. Chasing on inside @ 400m & 2 Lengths from lead on home turn. Pressured on rail @ 250m & outsprinted Two Wide in last 200m. # Every Chance

Pushed to quicken 3 Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & boxed on gamely Two Wide in last 150m. # Worked/tried hard
